violation_type.title: Transportation Safety Training-Primary Caregiver and Employee Transporting (26 TAC §747.1314)
violation_type.short_title: Transportation Safety Training-Primary Caregiver and Employee Transporting
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not have the required transportation training.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver did not have the required transportation training.
Transportation training was not available for review.
The provider did not complete the required transportation training
The primary caregiver did not have transportation training.
Substitute caregiver who transports children from school to the home daycare is missing two hours of annual required safety and transportation training.
In review of records for HASA, permit holder nor a caregiver transporting children has transportation training.
